t: Forge Steel 8-piece combination spanner set offers a versatile solution for tightening and loosening metric fasteners in various applications. Constructed from robust carbon steel, each spanner is hardened and chrome-plated, ensuring excellent abrasion and corrosion resistance to prolong tool life in demanding environments. The twin-ended set includes both open and 12-point ring ends, to provide improved access for engineers and mechanics working on applications such as vehicle maintenance, machinery, or plumbing installations. Includes a tool holder for organised storage and easy transportation.
